description: Calculate how long a file takes to download or upload at a given connection speed. Enter file size and transfer rate — get days, hours, minutes and seconds.

faqs.q: Why is my download slower than my plan's speed?
faqs.a: Advertised speeds are in megabits per second (Mbps); file sizes are in megabytes (MB). Divide by 8 to convert: 100 Mbps ≈ 12.5 MB/s before overhead.

faqs.q: Does it use 1000 or 1024 for KB/MB?
faqs.a: Decimal (SI): 1 KB = 1,000 bytes, 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes, matching how ISPs and drive makers quote figures.
Real transfers lose ~5–10% to TCP/IP and protocol overhead, so add a margin to the theoretical time shown.

howto: Enter the file size and choose its unit (B, KB, MB, GB, TB).
Enter the transfer speed and choose its unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps).
The transfer time appears instantly as days, hours, minutes and seconds.
Compare seconds, minutes and hours totals for planning.
title: Data Transfer Time Calculator
